ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.role: Explanatory paragraph in the Keyboard shortcuts settings section, above the shortcut rows
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.tone: Calm, factual second person; the reason is stated without blame or apology.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings content column (about 60-70 characters per line); no length cap, keep every fact. English is 287 characters.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.note: Explains why the browser's own shortcuts seem dead from elsewhere in the app: they answer only while the browser pane or a page inside it has focus. Names the group by job (new tab, reopen tab, the browser address bar, switching tabs) instead of spelling the chords, because the keymap registry is the only place a chord is spelled; use the target language's own terms for those actions. Reload is deliberately NOT in that group: it is dual-scope, so its own row states both outcomes. The middle sentence gives the reason: the app must not take those chords away from the rest of the interface. The last sentence is the instruction the reader needs: focus the browser first.

ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.length: One short wrapping paragraph; keep all three actions and their effects.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.note: Applies to panel and speech-to-text shortcuts. Esc clears only the current cue; it does not undo a saved shortcut. Keep Reset and Esc consistent with their controls.

ui.settings.shortcuts.recording.inactive.tone: Factual and actionable; recording is off because another named row owns the chord.

ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.primary.role: Rank label of the first speech-to-text shortcut row
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.primary.tone: Neutral one-word label in sentence case.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.primary.length: One word; sits in a 128px column above the action name.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.primary.note: Pairs with 'Secondary': the first and the second way to do the same thing, not a priority or a permission level. The action it ranks is named on the line beneath.

ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.secondary.role: Rank label of the second speech-to-text shortcut row
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.secondary.tone: Neutral one-word label in sentence case.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.secondary.length: One word; sits in a 128px column above the action name.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.secondary.note: Pairs with 'Primary'. Names the alternative way to start the same recording, not a lower-quality or backup feature.

ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.start_recor.role: Action name under the Primary label in Speech to text
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.start_recor.tone: Imperative action phrase, then the gesture in parentheses.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.start_recor.length: Short; sits in a 128px column and may wrap.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.start_recor.note: 'Start recording' is the same action as the composer's mic button label. '(press)' means a key combination pressed once, as opposed to '(hold)' on the other row. Keep the two parenthetical words contrasting.

ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.role: Action name under the Secondary label in Speech to text
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.tone: Imperative action phrase, then the gesture in parentheses.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.length: Short; sits in a 128px column and may wrap.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.note: Push to talk is the walkie-talkie idiom: record only while a key is held down. '(hold)' means the key is held and released, as opposed to '(press)' on the other row. Keep the two parenthetical words contrasting.

ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.role: Hint under the Push to talk field while it has focus
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.tone: Concise instruction in the register of the sibling capture hint.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.note: The user presses a single modifier key (Control, Option, Command, Windows or Super) to choose which key is held. Esc cancels the capture. Keep consistent with 'Press the keys you want; Esc cancels.' used for the other row.

ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.role: Refusal under the Push to talk field when the key pressed cannot be held
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.tone: Factual and actionable; names the keys that do work.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.note: The three arms name the modifier keys on that platform's keyboard: macOS has Control, Option and Command; Windows has Control and the Windows key; other systems have Control and the Super key. Use each platform's usual key names. Each arm is a complete sentence. Keep the select keywords darwin, win32 and other verbatim.

placeholders.platform: Platform keyword: darwin, win32 or other; never displayed.

ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.role: Warning note under the Push to talk field
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.tone: Factual, calm; a cost to weigh, not an error.
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.note: The held key is also the first key of ordinary shortcuts. {modifier} is the key's name without its side (Command, Control, Option); {example} is one affected shortcut written as keys (for example Command+C). {alternative} is the name of a key that avoids the problem, or the word none when no other key is free; keep 'none' as the select branch name, never show it. The microphone starts for an instant until the next key cancels it.

placeholders.modifier: The held key's name without its side: Command, Control or Option. Keep as given.
placeholders.example: One affected shortcut written as key names joined by plus signs, for example Command+J. Keep as given.
placeholders.alternative: The name of a key that avoids the problem (Option, Control, Command), or the word none; never displayed when none.

ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.role: Second sentence of the hint and of the refusal under the Push to talk field
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.push_to_tal.note: Shown after another sentence; 'Start recording' is the name of the row directly above (the Primary box) and must match its translated action name.

ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.start_recor.role: Refusal under the Start recording field
ui.settings.shortcuts.speech.start_recor.note: Shown when the user pressed only a modifier key (Command, Control, Option, Shift) in the field that records a shortcut.
